text:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: release v2.19.0 -> prod (canary 10%). Postdeploy smoke starting now. Watchers: eng-releases.
Sara: saw a p95 jump on synthetic sampler for embed-route in eu-west shortly after traffic shift. small spike but noticeable.
Jamal: same, noticed a handful of 502s in the synth run. not reflected in backend error budget yet.
ops-bot: synthetic-probe: 2026-03-21T14:05:40Z region=eu-west sampler=1000ms window=5m fail_rate=3.8% p95_latency=420ms anomalies=3
Michael: can we confirm these are probe-only (synthetic) and not real client errors? any 5xx uplifts in prod?
Sara: production client metrics look fine, 5xx stable. probe variance seems correlated with sampler cadence (1s).
Jamal: hypothesis: sampler granularity at 1s is aliasing with a periodic job causing transient errors. propose temporary decrease to 200ms for the synth probe for faster signal.
katie: +1 to finer granularity for short duration. add small random jitter so probes don't sync.
Michael: suggest resample window shorten from 5m -> 2m during the experiment so we can react faster. if noise drops, we can revert to standard settings.
Sara: operational plan: set sampler=200ms, jitter=0.05s, window=2m for 15m. escalate if client 5xx > 0.5% or probe fail_rate > 5%. rollback if sustained after 20m.
Jamal: I pushed a quick gating patch to deploybot config:
```
/patch synth-config embed-route {
  sampler_ms: 200
  jitter_sec: 0.05
  window_min: 2
  annotate: "temp-finer-sample-2026-03-21"
}
```
ops-bot: Patch applied; running quick resample job across eu regions for 15 minutes. run_id=rs-20260321-01
ops-bot: Resample job started at 2026-03-21T14:08:10Z (sampler=200ms window=2m).
Sara: pinned model variant for embed-route to v2.19.0-rc1 for canary traffic while we observe. pin_id=pin-20260321-embed-rc1
Michael: good call on pinning. minimizes scope if we need to roll forward.
Jamal: watchlist updated: dashboard + alert rule (probe_fail_rate > 1% for 1m) and a slack alert channel.
katie: documenting the decision in release notes section: "finer probe sampling experiment postdeploy; no client impact observed; monitoring in place"
ops-bot: Postdeploy quick-check T+5m: no client-side 5xx increase detected :white_check_mark: probe fail_rate=2.1% (down from 3.8%).
Sara: keeping an eye for another 10m, if metrics hold we'll remove the temporary config and unpin in 30m.
Michael: if probe noisiness returns after reverting, we should consider changing the long-term sampler to 250ms or track down the periodic job causing interference.
Jamal: will run a brief trace correlation between synthetic probe timestamps and background maintenance tasks. sharing results in 10m.
ops-bot: Postdeploy quick-check T+15m: probe_fail_rate=0.9% windowed, client 5xx=unchanged. Recommendation: rollforward (no rollback) and revert sampler to baseline with a follow-up ticket to investigate root cause.
Sara: agree — no rollback. creating follow-up ticket INF-4721 to investigate background job and long-term sampling policy.
katie: noted, adding release note line and closing watchlist if no regressions for next 30m.
Michael: thanks all — stand down unless alerts fire. :relieved:
deploy-bot: Canaries stable, no rollback required. marking release v2.19.0 as "postdeploy: manual watch complete".
Sara: closing thread, will reopen if noisy metrics reappear.
